titulo: Give me five, then I'll come back
caption:
Give me five, then I'll come back

"Good time to talk?" "Give me five!" "I'll come back." Nobody got interrupted.

Asking whether it is a good time takes ten seconds and protects the other person's focus.

For whoever asks if it is a good time first.

Choose friction.
